
{{alias}}( x, dims, writable )
    Returns a view of an input ndarray in which two specified dimensions are
    swapped.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: ndarray
        Input array.

    dims: ArrayLikeObject<integer>
        Indices of dimensions to swap. If provided an integer less than zero,
        the dimension index is resolved relative to the last dimension, with
        the last dimension corresponding to the value `-1`.

    writable: boolean
        Boolean indicating whether a returned ndarray should be writable. This
        parameter only applies to ndarray constructors which support read-only
        instances.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ndarray
        Output array view.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/array}}( [ [ 1, 2, 3 ], [ 4, 5, 6 ] ] )
    <ndarray>[ [ 1, 2, 3 ], [ 4, 5, 6 ] ]
    > var y = {{alias}}( x, [ 0, 1 ], false )
    <ndarray>[ [ 1, 4 ], [ 2, 5 ], [ 3, 6 ] ]

    See Also
    --------
